query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718) AS source_pages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718) AS facts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718) AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718) AS mcqs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718) AS mcq_options, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718) AS verifications, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0714-0718:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d LEFT JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id LEFT JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id=m.id WHERE (f.source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718) OR (m.source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718)) AS search_documents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a LEFT JOIN public.gk_facts f ON a.entity_type='fact' AND a.entity_id=f.id LEFT JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON a.entity_type='mcq' AND a.entity_id=m.id WHERE (f.source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718) OR (m.source_page BETWEEN 714 AND 718)) AS tag_assignments LIMIT 1;
